address: Hanson Bay, Kangaroo Island, South Australia
tagline: Twenty-five cliff suites at Hanson Bay, reopened in 2023.
description:
Southern Ocean Lodge stands at Hanson Bay on the southwest coast of Kangaroo Island, South Australia. James and Hayley Baillie, founders of what is now Beckons, commissioned the Kangaroo Island-born architect Max Pritchard. The lodge opened in 2008, was destroyed in the 2020 bushfires, and reopened in 2023 as the present building. Twenty-five suites follow the limestone cliffs, each looking over the Southern Ocean. Children of ten years and over are welcomed. Kangaroo Island Airport (KGC) is a 50-minute drive, and the flight from Adelaide takes 40 minutes. Return transfers that meet scheduled flights are included. The island sits 15 kilometres from the mainland and measures 155 kilometres by 55.

The Great Room is the centre of the lodge, with an open bar and a wet-edge pool on the terrace. Check-in is at 2pm and check-out is at 10.30am. The tariff includes breakfast, lunch and dinner, an open bar of premium wines and spirits, an in-suite bar, signature island experiences and the airport transfers. A cellarmaster's list is extra. Sunset drinks are served in the Great Room. Executive Chef Gianni Hendrickx, who worked in Michelin-starred kitchens in Bruges, writes the daily menu.

The Baillie Pavilion sits beside the main lodge and joins an east wing and a west wing as one residence: four king bedrooms, two living rooms, two heated plunge pools, and 625 square metres indoors and out, for up to eight guests. It includes sunset drinks in the suite, private airport transfers, private touring and a dedicated host. Guests staying three nights or more may take in-suite dining with a private chef on the last night.

The Southern Spa is reached by a glass-walled bridge. It has three treatment rooms, a chill lounge, a gym, a sauna and hot and cold plunge pools. Treatments use the alkeme range by Aphra Skye Heron and Kangaroo Island botanicals, including Ligurian honey from the island's hives, described as the only pure strain of that bee.

Southern Ocean Lodge suits travellers who want a cliff stay on Kangaroo Island with meals and drives included, and a separate pavilion when a group needs four bedrooms.
